title: Issue 06 — mark multi-region cap-breakers UNOBTAINABLE (keepOn hosts + req)
policy: keepOn-style: removeUpgrade hosts outside the keep set; editUpgrade or upsertUpgrade on keep hosts.
On each keep host: regionId=host, requiredRegions=ruling list, UNOBTAINABLE tag in detail.
UNOBTAINABLE tag text: 'UNOBTAINABLE under Equilibrium 3-elective cap (region pressure exceeds picks).'
Do not edit catalog.json in this pass — ops only.
Do not touch Artificer's measure component region map.

ops.name: Blessed flask production chain
ops.reason: B9 Blessed flask: keep only desert/morytania/tirannwn/forinthry hosts

ops.name: Blessed flask production chain

set.comboLabel: Region combo (all required): desert + morytania + tirannwn + forinthry
set.detail: This is a real region-planning chain because no trading makes the ingredient sources matter, but it would be wrong to display Desert + Tirannwn + Karamja + Forinthry as four unconditional required picks while alternate supply routes and the unresolved Arc exist. Keep the full pressure visible instead. · Re-evaluate individual ingredient gates when Equilibrium publishes external-area handling, quest auto-completion details, or League-specific supply passives. · Effects: Holds up to 80 doses of extreme prayer in one inventory slot, At level 99 Prayer, 80 doses can represent up to 45,200 Prayer points before other modifiers, Holy wrench increases the Prayer restored per extreme-prayer dose and works with the Blessed flask · Region pressure: Desert: the normal direct source for the 1,200 red sandstone used in the shell chain; alternate account sources can weaken this as a hard region gate., Tirannwn: crystal-flecked sandstone and 5,000 harmonic dust are naturally supplied through Prifddinas; some alternate sources mean this is recorded as pressure rather than an unconditional hard gate., Karamja: Holy water production is learned through Legends' Quest and uses the Kharazi Jungle water pool., Forinthry: Corporeal Beast is the practical normal self-supply source for the holy elixir and several required stone spirits; the tormented wraith is an alternate holy-elixir source., External unresolved: 250 alaea sea salt comes from the Arc/Wushanko chain, which is not currently assigned to an Equilibrium elective region. · User: mark unobtainable — needs Desert + Morytania + Tirannwn + Wilderness. · UNOBTAINABLE under Equilibrium 3-elective cap (region pressure exceeds picks).
